summary: Interpreted the D06 gate without recommending a design: READY is design-only authority for a separate implementation plan and requires substantive completeness plus durable panel/reviewer/red-team and promotion evidence; NOT READY is forced by any unmet gate. The current supplemental override binds all actors to Codex but does not waive distinct protocol actors or independence, creating a material conflict with the older inline-panel-waiver record. The report also identifies unresolved provenance/recheck, promotion-coverage, closeout-state, and decision-authority ambiguities, while finding no explicit locked-platform-law change in the listed artifacts.
